title: runtime: cut 1.18.1-lts tags + publish generated LTS release notes
author: Connor O'Brien
description: This PR finalizes the first Runtime LTS patch release on the runtime-1.18-lts line by (1) generating and committing the 1.18.1-lts slower-change release notes (taxonomy + required metadata), (2) adding the release tags/manifests used by build/publish automation, and (3) wiring in the known-issues + compatibility matrix snapshot for this patch. Motivation: Dedicated/Private customers piloting the LTS channel need an auditable, stable baseline with predictable patch artifacts and human-readable notes (categorized, with perf deltas + upgrade guidance). Scope: no functional changes beyond release metadata; code fixes included in 1.18.1-lts were merged via separate backport PRs (notably KV cache compaction crash fix + scheduler starvation edge-case). Release artifacts produced by CI for this PR are traceable to the tagged commit and include checksums/provenance. Tagging plan: runtime-v1.18.1-lts (runtime engine), images runtime:1.18.1-lts / runtime:1.18.1-lts-<gitsha> for Private pinning, and chart annotation links to these notes. Checklist: - [x] perf-canary gate green (see CI summary) - [x] scheduler regression suite green - [x] SBOM generation step runs and attaches output - [x] provenance + checksums emitted for runtime image + tarball - [x] notes include Known Issues + mitigations + backport policy pointer - [x] SRE sign-off for rollout monitoring + rollback guidance. Follow-ups: ENG-4833 pilot rollout comms will reference the release note URL and checksum bundle; Support playbook updated separately.

release_notes: Runtime LTS 1.18.1-lts (Patch) — 2025-03-21

Summary: First patch release on runtime-1.18-lts with focus on crash fixes + scheduler fairness under bursty traffic; no feature additions. Includes reproducible artifacts with checksums/provenance and slower-change release notes taxonomy.
Backported fixes:
- [Sev1] KV cache compaction crash fix (prevents runtime crash under specific long-context + eviction patterns).
- [Sev2] Scheduler starvation edge-case under bursty mixed-length traffic (improves fairness; reduces tail latency spikes).
Stability / Predictability:

- Kernel autotune defaults frozen for LTS line to reduce performance variance across identical deployments; override supported via documented env var (not recommended for production without perf validation).
- Experimental batching heuristic remains disabled on LTS to prioritize predictability (may reduce peak throughput vs mainline).
Performance notes (perf-canary):
- p50 latency: within ±2% of 1.18.0 baseline across canonical workloads.
- p95 latency: improved on bursty mixed-length workload (see gate summary artifact); no regressions beyond allowed thresholds.
Compatibility matrix (high level):
- Supported GPUs: A100, H100, L40S (see matrix for driver/CUDA minimums).
- Hosted/Dedicated: compatible with Redwood control plane 2025.03+.
- Private: requires installer >= 0.19.0 and Helm chart >= 1.31.0 for LTS pinning annotations.
Upgrade notes:
- Recommended for all pilot LTS accounts; optional for general LTS channel users unless impacted by crash/starvation symptoms.
- Dedicated: roll out region-by-region; monitor LTS SLO dashboard for 30–60 minutes before next region. Rollback supported via previous LTS patch tag.
- Private: pin runtime image tag to 1.18.1-lts; verify sha256 checksum bundle before promotion; rollback by restoring previous pinned tag and re-running health checks.
Known issues (unchanged):
- Under extreme overload, request queue depth metrics may under-report by up to ~5% (visualization issue; does not affect behavior). Workaround: use request-age histogram panel.
- Rare perf gate flake on shared benchmark runners; rerun required before waivers (no waivers used for this patch).
Security:
- No new CVEs addressed in this patch. Security response for LTS follows standard process with out-of-band patch capability and expedited approvals when needed.
